proposition: Ibn Turka died in Herat on Monday 14 Dhū l-Ḥijja 835/12 August 1432, aged 63, frustrated, impoverished and in limbo.

mediation.who: Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr editor's introduction, xlvii

mediation.note: the age of 63 does not fit the birth year 770 derived from Nafsat I (which gives about 65); see R1 notes
